import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('CREATE TABLE artists (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE)')
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE albums (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, artist_id INTEGER)')

def artist_id(name):
    # استرجع المفتاح إن كان الفنان معروفًا / retrieve the key if the artist is known
    cur.execute('SELECT id FROM artists WHERE name = ? LIMIT 1', (name,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        # أضف الصف وخذ المفتاح الجديد / add the row and take its new key
        cur.execute('INSERT INTO artists (name) VALUES (?)', (name,))
        return cur.lastrowid
    return row[0]

for title, artist in [('Ahdan', 'Fairuz'), ('Kifak Inta', 'Fairuz'), ('Houdou Nisbi', 'Ziad Rahbani')]:
    aid = artist_id(artist)
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO albums (title, artist_id) VALUES (?, ?)', (title, aid))
conn.commit()

cur.execute('SELECT id, name FROM artists')
print(cur.fetchall())
cur.execute('SELECT title, artist_id FROM albums')
print(cur.fetchall())
conn.close()
